reviewMethod: Fresh control/data flow review of every web application source, hook, helper, stylesheet and test/config support file. Test suites received explicit structural/import/case/key-assertion inspection plus implementation cross-reference; selected media/session/conversion/history suites and new operation-history assertions received deeper fixture review. This does not claim line-by-line semantic review of every test fixture.
prioritization: Real user workflows first: new/existing/archived conversations, provider-scoped model choice and independent conversion, safe draft handoff, auto-resume/queued goals, child agents, project mutation/sidebar refresh, account/MCP/extensions/files/Git, recovery, image presentation, mobile and accessibility.

findings.title: Valid generated images exceed live event and full-history budgets before their supported preview can be shown
findings.trigger: One 3 MiB generated raster produces 4,194,304 base64 characters; the live envelope exceeds the 2,000,000-character browser event budget and 4 MiB gateway buffer, while history exceeds the 4,000,000-character total window.
findings.impact: Disconnect/reconnect cannot restore a usable synchronized conversation; valid image content either blocks the whole history or fails before the preview that claims up to 4 MiB support.
findings.recommendation: Normalize generated inline images to bounded metadata on every runtime exit; read thread-authorized chunks on explicit preview/download; verify identity, offsets, sizes and final SHA256 before object URL publication; retain existing event/history bounds.

findings.title: Provider editor guidance promises direct cross-provider continuation after deletion
findings.trigger: Existing conversation is provider locked; user removes its provider after reading the editor text promising any enabled provider can continue its history.
findings.impact: The retained conversation needs the original provider restored before supported conversion can load it; misleading guidance encourages an avoidable unusable state.
findings.recommendation: Explain same-provider existing-thread picker and deliberate independent conversion, and require converting needed threads before provider removal or restoring the original provider afterward.

findings.title: Changing models displayed target default effort but omitted the override and inherited the previous effort
findings.trigger: An existing conversation uses high; select another model whose directory default is medium. The composer cleared effort but displayed medium. Actual CLI turn/start with omitted effort retained high. collaborationMode.settings.reasoning_effort:null has the separate reset-to-default semantics.
findings.impact: The displayed reasoning effort and actual request differ; null config on cold resume also causes a native failure (runtime-owned finding).
findings.recommendation: Selecting an allowed catalog default submits its exact value. Label omitted effort as inheritance, preserve same-provider/verified-alias known thread effort across collaboration modes, and do not invent configurable overrides for fixed-effort models.
